texts.text: Periodic Inscription of Isosceles Trapezoids Ali Naseri Sadr

texts.label: text
texts.orig: We prove that a of continuous disjoint periodic curves in C inscribes an isosceles trapezoid with any similarity type. The case of smooth curves can be identified with Lagrangian intersection problem for of Lagrangian cylinders in R x S1 x C; and the continuous case follows from the smooth one by a standard convergence argument pair pair

texts.orig: For any given isosceles trapezoid Q, we show there are four points in ~1(R)U 72(R) that are vertices of quadrilateral similar to Q. The approach of [5] does not directly generalize even to the case of rectangles. By contrast; in this article; we use a different approach to prove not only that every of periodic curves inscribes every similarity type of rectangles; but also every similarity type of isosceles trapezoids. pair
